text:
Platinum Price in 2003
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2003, the LBMA platinum price rose 21.9% between 2003-01-31 ($667) and 2003-12-30 ($813). The highest sampled price was $813 in December and the lowest was $603 in April. The mean of these observations was $695. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
